scope: English, supplied series/date, six unchanged V5 operations; no production native integration or AGI claim
training: Original public V5 training only. A fixed compact hand-authored concept encoder is learned through linear coefficients; no pretrained model, teacher API, or original held material.
development: Original public V5 selection calibrates candidates; original public V5 development diagnoses implementation. Up to three disclosed development revisions, all retained; freeze before independent evaluation.
candidate_budget: At most six learned configurations per revision, one deterministic contract parser, original eight-candidate V5 reproduction; one seed because convex fits do not create independent language observations.
selection: Final disclosed development revision c: among selection pairs with zero observed OOD false acceptance, maximize correct known accepted, then minimize wrong known, false OOD, artifact bytes and candidate name. Include reject-all. Independent held criteria remain coverage >=0.8 and OOD false acceptance <=0.05. Prior a/b revisions used <=0.05 selection target and are fully retained.

new_held.author: separate parent assistant, synthetic not human

prohibited: claim learned features are pretrained semantic embeddings
structure_experiment: After semantic freeze, equal primitive evaluations and serialized state for static shared and local-dispatched layouts on identical numeric traces; report absence of growth benefit if no evidence. No automatic production splitting.
runtime: CPU; no torch, GPU, model downloads, teacher calls or production load; numpy/scipy/scikit-learn versions match V5
